contradiction.consumerRule: The predecessor requires APR-002 and HRM-010 Auth admission and V59 comparison before APR-002 native creation.
contradiction.terminalChildRule: The predecessor also permits HRM-010 DRAIN_EXISTING only for its exact persisted root or deterministic terminal child, whose callbackEventId, occurredAt and payload digest do not exist at APR-002 root ingress.
contradiction.unsafeInterpretationForbidden: APR-002 approvalRequestId, requestedAt or payload digest must never be substituted as HRM-010 callback selectors or recorded as false HRM-010 drain activity.

newWorkApr002Ingress: Resolve APR-002 and HRM-010 under NEW_WORK before native request creation.
Require the same grantSetId, tenantGrantRevision and authorizationRevision and exact-compare the immutable V59 two-member projection.
drainApr002RootIngress: Resolve APR-002 as the exact DRAIN_EXISTING ROOT_DELIVERY and resolve SVC-AUT-HRM-013 only as the exact DEPENDENT_READ needed by that root.

Require both returned authorizations to identify the same old grantSetId, tenantGrantRevision, authorizationRevision and common quiesceEffectiveAt, and cap the dependent-read proof and local transaction by the earlier drainAuthorizationExpiresAt.
Exact-compare the current highest ADMIT V59 row common fields and APR-002 member with the Auth result and validate the row's immutable HRM-010 projection fields.

Rely only on the sealed Auth three-member waiver-group atomicity for the not-yet-materialized HRM-010 member; do not call HRM-010 with APR-002 root selectors and do not append HRM-010 drain activity at ingress.
terminalChildCreationAndDelivery: Before every HRM-010 terminal outbox creation, resolve HRM-010 as its exact TERMINAL_CHILD and APR-002 as the exact ROOT_DELIVERY under the same old grantSetId, revisions and common quiesceEffectiveAt.
Exact-compare both Auth results to the same immutable V59 row and fail before commit if either authorization is mismatched, changed or expired.

Before every HRM-010 delivery attempt, freshly repeat both exact resolutions and comparisons, cap the business-proof expiry by the earlier drainAuthorizationExpiresAt, then fail before proof signing or network send if either result changed or expired.
clarification.scope: This clarification applies only to APR-002 DRAIN_EXISTING root ingress and its deterministic HRM-010 terminal child. It does not relax NEW_WORK, requester identity, replay, proof, V59 immutability, TLS, credential, step-up, maker-checker, audit or fail-closed rules.
